verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-action feature such as batch edit, tag, delete or re-run. The only evidence of acting on many items at once is a hands-on report that users can export all their requests, plus the request query API and HQL for querying across many records. These are read-only bulk retrieval, not bulk mutation. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/tag/score operations across many requests, first-party docs describing bulk export, batch API endpoints for mutations.
